decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: 1487-P2-01; 51487-P2-02; 51487-P2-03; 51487-E2-01: 51487-E2-02; 51487-XX-P1-01-SLP;  covering letter (28th February 2024); Transport Technical Note Report Ref. 2206761-R02; Transport Note Addendum – Cycle Parking; Provisional Delivery And Servicing Management Plan Report Ref. 2206761-R01; BS4142 Assessment of Elite Cars (Noise report)

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The proposed use(s) hereby permitted shall not
be in operation outside of the hours specified within the Provisional Delivery
and Servicing Management Plan (07:30am – 18:30pm from Monday to Sunday,
including Bank Holidays).</p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">Notwithstanding the details provided within
the Provisional Delivery and Servicing Management Plan, within 3 months (or any
other such period that is agreed in writing by the local planning authority) of
the date of this permission, &nbsp;the
applicant shall provide a Parking Management Plan to demonstrate how
unauthorised parking on site is to be restricted. The Parking Management Plan
shall thereafter be maintained in accordance with the details as so approved,
unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority. <font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal;tab-stops:49.65pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;
mso-fareast-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;mso-font-kerning:0pt;mso-ligatures:
none;mso-fareast-language:EN-GB">&nbsp;</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The MOT use hereby permitted shall be operated
on an appointment only basis and the activities associated with MOT testing
shall only take place within the MOT Testing Station.&nbsp; Any plant and machinery which may be used by
reason of granting this permission, shall be so installed, used and thereafter
retained as to prevent the transmission of noise and vibration into any
neighbouring premises; no amplified speech or music generated from the site
will be audible within the adjoining residential premises at any time<span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;
mso-fareast-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;mso-font-kerning:0pt;mso-ligatures:
none;mso-fareast-language:EN-GB">.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal;tab-stops:49.65pt"><br></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">Notwithstanding the details provided within
the Provisional Delivery and Servicing Management Plan, within 3 months (or any
other such period that is agreed in writing by the local planning authority) of
the date of this permission, a detailed Delivery and Servicing Plan shall be
submitted to, and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The Delivery and Servicing Plan shall include
full details of the operation of the site, and the number and timings of
delivery and servicing movements. The Delivery and Service Plan shall confirm
if Large Goods Vehicles (trucks and fixed wheelbase lorries or articulated
lorries) will be used to service the site.&nbsp;
If so, the Local Planning Authority requires that such vehicles can
enter and exit the site and manoeuvre around the site safely as demonstrated in
relevant SWEPT path analysis drawings, to be approved in writing.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">Delivery and servicing arrangements shall
thereafter be carried out in accordance with the details as so agreed, unless
otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal;tab-stops:49.65pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;
mso-fareast-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;mso-font-kerning:0pt;mso-ligatures:
none;mso-fareast-language:EN-GB">&nbsp;</span></p><p>











</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal;tab-stops:49.65pt"><br></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">Within 3 months of the date of this permission
(or any other such period that is agreed in writing by the local planning
authority) , details of proposed cycle parking shall be submitted to, and
approved and writing by the Local Planning Authority. <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The submitted details shall indicate the exact
siting of proposed cycle storage, elevation drawings shall be provided
detailing the full proportions and appearance of the cycle store(s), proposed
long stay cycle parking shall be indicated to be securely enclosed. <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The development shall be carried out in
accordance with the details as so agreed prior to the first occupation of the
development and shall be retained thereafter. <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">Other than when in use, cycles shall be stored
at all times within the designated storage areas indicated within the submitted
details.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal;tab-stops:49.65pt"><br></p>
